name: ship-pipeline
description: Nine repo-agnostic skills for the ship half of the development loop: issue intake, live-schema grounding, evidence-backed verification, report-only slop review, review/PR/merge, production promotion, and a batch orchestrator that carries several issues through all of it. Every skill detects the repo's own conventions and defers to a repo-local override when one exists.

interface.shortDescription: Issue intake to production, with evidence at every gate
interface.longDescription: Nine repo-agnostic skills covering the ship half of the development loop. start-issue reads the whole issue and branches correctly. db-truth grounds every schema claim in the live database. prove-it inverts the burden of proof at the end of work, emitting a claim-command-result evidence table where anything unprovable is labeled UNVERIFIED rather than assumed. review-slop reports evidence-backed maintainability and validation findings without editing files. review-merge-pipeline runs verify-review-fix-commit-push-PR-merge in one shot, detecting the repo's integration branch instead of assuming one. deploy promotes to production. db-migration-safety and backup-verify cover the expand-contract pattern and restore-tested backups. ship-issues takes a batch of issues through the whole loop, grouping them into branches and validating against production after deploy. Each skill defers to a repo-local version of itself when the project defines one.
capabilities: Reads GitHub issues and creates correctly-named branches
Verifies live database schema before and after migrations
Runs typecheck, build, and targeted tests, then emits an evidence table
Creates and merges pull requests against the detected integration branch
Promotes an integration branch to production
Reports slop findings with evidence and acceptance criteria, without editing
Ships a batch of issues from intake to production in one run
